sqlquery.from:
(select coalesce(ld.firstName,'')||' '||coalesce(ld.lastName,'') leadName, * from "$".crmcontact ld where ld.deleted is not true and ld.contacttype = 5) ld left join (select coalesce(ass.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(ass.lastname,'') assigneeName,* from "$".myuser ass) ass ON ass.id = ld.assignee left join (select coalesce(backupAss.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(backupAss.lastname,'') backupAssigneeName,* from "$".myuser backupass) backupass ON backupass.id = ld.backupassignee
left join "$".reference rtg on rtg.id = ld.rating
left join "$".reference sou on sou.id = ld.source left join "$".campaign cgn on cgn.id = ld.campaign left join "$".reference st on st.id = ld.status
LEFT JOIN "$".address ca ON ca.contactid = ld.id AND ca.entityType= 'contact' LEFT JOIN "public".country co ON co.id = ca.countryid
left join "$".employeecustomfields cf on ld.owner=cf.id
LEFT JOIN (select ld.id, count(rel.id) eventCount from (select id from "$".crmcontact ld where ld.deleted is not true and ld.contacttype = 5) ld join "$".relation rel on ((rel.toid = ld.id and rel.totype = 'event') or (rel.fromid = ld.id and rel.fromtype = 'event')) group by ld.id) rel on rel.id=ld.id LEFT JOIN "$".crmaccount cac ON cac.id = ld.crmaccount left join "$".reference ind on ind.id = cac.industry left join "$".reference annualRevenue on annualRevenue.id = cac.annualRevenueId left join "$".reference numberOfEmployees on numberOfEmployees.id = cac.numberOfEmployeesId
left join (select coalesce(owner.firstname,'') ||' '|| coalesce(owner.lastname,'') ownername, id from "$".myuser owner) own on ld.owner=own.id
left join ( select distinct owneremploye.id, pos.name positName, (co1.name ||', '|| lo.city) team,el.startDate , el.endDate from "$".employee owneremploye left join "$".position pos ON owneremploye.positionid = pos.id and pos.isDeleted is not true left join "$".employeelocation el on owneremploye.id = el.userid left join "$".location lo on el.locationid = lo.id left join "public".country co1 on lo.countryid = co1.id) owner ON owner.id = ld.owner and ld.creationDate between coalesce(owner.startDate,'1990-08-08 12:19:03.224') and coalesce(owner.endDate,now())
left join ( select distinct owneremploye.id, pos.name assigneepositName, (co1.name ||', '|| lo.city) assigneeteam,el.startDate assigneeStartDate, el.endDate assigneeEndDate from "$".employee owneremploye left join "$".position pos ON owneremploye.positionid = pos.id and pos.isDeleted is not true left join "$".employeelocation el on owneremploye.id = el.userid left join "$".location lo on el.locationid = lo.id left join "public".country co1 on lo.countryid = co1.id) assignee ON assignee.id = ld.assignee and ld.creationDate between coalesce(assignee.assigneeStartDate,'1990-08-08 12:19:03.224') and coalesce(assignee.assigneeEndDate,now())
LEFT JOIN "$".crmcontactitemparams websites ON websites.contactid = ld.id AND websites.relationid = 1 and websites.paramid = 4

terms.value: ld.deleted is not true and ld.contacttype = 5
